title: Magnetic-map-matching Navigation For Odometry Using Low-cost Mobile Robot
authors: Y. H. Kim; Y. Seo Kwon; J. W. Song
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Map_Based_Localization to ensure precise positioning.
